caption:
Stock market news | SEBI announces Five-day FPI onboarding, simpler disclosures

SEBI outlined major regulatory reforms, introducing a five-day onboarding process for foreign portfolio investors and simpler disclosure requirements.

The changes aim to simplify compliance, broaden market access and strengthen India's capital markets, encouraging greater investor participation.
